title.narrative: Trade, Private Sector development and engagement, and regional Facility II

description.narrative: This action builds on the successful implementation of the 'Trade, Private Sector Development and Engagement, and regional integration Facility (TPSDE Facility I). The TPSDE Facility II will provide technical and support services to improve the capacity of EU delegations and headquarters to programme, design and implement TPSDE interventions using the available programming tools. In particular, the project will: Provide advisory services (technical support) throughout the whole project cycle of the respective actions (including mainstreaming private sector development and engagement under other sectors) in order to improve the effectiveness of EU interventions and to strengthen Commission¿s capacity to better measure and monitor interventions in TPSDE area; ¿ Promote knowledge sharing and management to reinforce technical capacity of EU staff, as well as beneficiary countries, particularly in those partner countries where trade and private sector development are emphasised as priority sectors; ¿ Enhance communication, visibility and coherence of the EU trade, private sector development and engagement, and regional integration (TPSDE) related interventions through better communication and coordination among programmes and projects
